comparison.meaning_effect_6_3: Same stillborn-versus-man comparison; word order alone does not require different English
comparison.wlc_6_4: כי בהבל בא ובחשך ילך ובחשך שמו יכסה
comparison.reported_scroll_base_6_4: כי בהבל בה ובחושך שמ֯ו יכסה

comparison.limits: Stage assemblies are analytical readings of published addition/deletion notation, not own pixels, an independent witness, verified hand attribution or manuscript vocalization
comparison.departure_analysis: הלך admits a plausible perfect went; unpointed participial analysis remains possible. Its missing prefix differs from WLC ילך; spelling alone does not certify tense or transmission direction.
comparison.arrival_analysis: בה versus בא can represent final-he/aleph spelling of arrival; no new arrival meaning established

illustrations.wlc: I said: better than he is the stillborn child. For it came in futility, goes in darkness, and in darkness its name is covered.
illustrations.corrected_scroll_assuming_perfect_depart: I said: the stillborn child is better than he. For it came in futility, went in darkness, and in darkness its name is covered.

comparison.not_attested_omission: Earlier clauses of 6:3 fall outside the inspected surviving segment; do not delete the hundred children, long life, appetite or burial on that basis

decision.source: Retain current pointed WLC provisionally for this unit
decision.main_english: Retain current POB generic-present wording; no necessary meaning correction established by these distinctions
decision.strongest_support: Repeated darkness expressions make an eye-skip in copying and subsequent repair plausible; the corrected scroll and inspected Greek preserve departure and name clauses
decision.strongest_objection: A shorter exemplar could have been expanded or assimilated in correction; the coherent base-line state and unclear corrector/exemplar relationship do not settle earliest wording
decision.chronology: The early witness merits comparison; no new physical dating or automatic oldest-state preference
decision.source_priority: Unresolved; neither correction date, motive, hand nor exemplar independently established
decision.reopening_condition: Passage-specific edition/hand evidence or a transmission argument distinguishing omission-and-repair from expansion; a second digital copy or another preference vote is insufficient

review.scope: One bounded independent source/English-effect assessment, not an identity-blinded translation evaluation
review.actual: Qualified retention; order/spelling not meaning reversal; corrected departure present, aspect/priority unresolved; supports both skip-and-repair and expansion possibilities
review.correction: Assessor adjacent mouth-suffix claim not imported: לפיהו matches segmented current WLC ל/פי/הו. Adjacent 6:6 conditional interpretation stays outside case.

verification.limit: Documentation-only comparison; historical aggregate registry debt remains, no new global-clean claim
